A '''hypospray''' or '''spray hypo''' was a medical instrument that was used to inject medicines into an individual's body. They were found in [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]], such as [[FastFlesh medpac/Legends|FastFlesh medpacs]].<ref name="EGWT" />
